messages:
Noah (marketing): FYI saw ~18 leads today marked enrichment:soft_fail during the APAC morning. A few were high-touch (score 92). We need a lightweight SLA gate so SDRs see urgent ones without creating ops noise.
Priya (ops): Agreed. Current flow marks soft_fail after 2 retries. Proposal: introduce a gating rule: only escalate into Ops ticketing when (1) retry_count >= 3 AND (2) hs_lead_score >= 80 OR company.size >= 50 OR last_30d_activity >= 3. Otherwise route into an overflow 'enrich-backfill' queue for automated re-ingest.
Daniel (growth): Love the overflow idea. Could we also apply a temporary round-robin freeze for leads that hit soft_fail so the same SDR doesn't get a broken handoff? e.g., set claim_sticky=false for 60m and put into overflow pool. This avoids churn when enrichment is flapping.
Sam (sdr): From SDR side: if score >=90, I want a Slack ping regardless of ticket. Quick DM with lead summary is fine. For others, putting into overflow that auto-retries is ideal. Also please skip ticketing for partner-owned leads.
Chris (sales-eng): Technical ask: when creating a ticket include presigned logs_url + last_response_code and a small sample of enrichment steps (redacted). And add tag 'rr-freeze' when we set the round-robin freeze so we can audit downstream.
ops-bot: alert: enrichment.soft_fail rate +230% vs baseline this morning. grouping: hubspot-webhook-timeouts.
Priya (ops): Implementation outline:
- HubSpot workflow: WHEN enrichment_status == 'soft_fail' AND retry_count >= 3 THEN POST to /internal/enrich-events.
- Internal service evaluates gates: if score >=90 -> post sales webhook; if score >=80 or company.size >=50 -> create ops ticket (dedupe by lead_id 24h); else -> enqueue to 'enrich-backfill' with rr-freeze TTL 60m.
- Tickets payload minimal: lead_id,email,company,hs_lead_score,last_response_code,logs_presigned_url,tags. No raw PII in the ticket body.
Daniel (growth): We'll add metrics: % auto-ticketed that resolve_no_action within 48h and conversion rate for sales-pings. Use those to tune score thresholds after a 72h experiment.
Noah (marketing): Sounds good. Can we also surface a quick UI flag in HubSpot for 'no_auto_ticket' so partners or manual owners can opt-out?
Priya (ops): Yes add owner_team check and a lead property 'no_auto_ticket' to skip.
Sam (sdr): One last ask: include a short debounce (15min) before sending sales DM to avoid storming SDRs during ingestion spikes.
Priya (ops): Will add 15m sales debounce. Next steps: I'll prototype the internal evaluator and backfill queue in staging (ETA 48h). Daniel will add experiment dashboard (ETA 24h). Noah will update the inbound runbook and communication to SDRs (ETA 72h).
Noah (marketing): Great — I'll schedule a 20m sync after staging smoke test. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
